image_prompts: A teacup with steam rising, indicating a preference for tea over coffee
Two paths diverging in a forest, one slightly more worn than the other
words.image_desc_en: A preference shown through tea and a slightly more worn path.
words.image_desc_cn: 通过茶和稍微磨损的小路来表示一种偏好。
words.collocations: rather than, would rather

examples.en: I would rather stay at home than go to the party.
examples.cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿去参加聚会。

examples.en: The exam was rather difficult, but I think I passed it.
examples.cn: 这次考试相当难，但我认为我通过了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果让你在两个选项中选择，你更倾向于哪个？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示在两者之间更喜欢一个。

sentences: She felt ___ tired after the long walk in the park.

image_prompts: A fork in a road with signs pointing to different destinations, one sign brighter than the other
Two cups of tea on a table, one with a flower next to it, the other plain
words.image_desc_en: Representing a preference between two options.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表在两个选项之间做出偏好选择。
words.usage: 情态动词短语。表示一种偏好或选择，后接动词原形。
words.collocations: would rather do sth than do sth; would rather not do sth

examples.en: I would rather stay at home than go to the party.
examples.cn: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿去参加聚会。

examples.en: She would rather read a book than watch TV tonight.
examples.cn: 她今晚宁愿看书也不愿看电视。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有两个选择，一个是去图书馆，一个是去购物，你觉得哪个更吸引你？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表达你更倾向于哪个选择。

sentences: They ___ go swimming than play basketball this afternoon.

image_prompts: A car's steering wheel with hands gripping it, road visible through windshield
A long winding road through a green valley, viewed from a high vantage point
words.image_desc_en: Driving a car on a road.
words.image_desc_cn: 在路上驾驶汽车。
words.usage: v. (过去式 drove, 过去分词 driven); n.
words.collocations: drive a car, drive someone crazy, drive to school

examples.en: I can drive my car to school every day now.
examples.cn: 我现在每天都可以开车去学校了。

examples.en: He will drive his family to the beach this summer.
examples.cn: 今年夏天他将开车带家人去海滩。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你需要操作方向盘并控制车辆前进，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作通常与车辆的移动有关。

sentences: She learned to ___ a car when she was eighteen years old.

image_prompts: A car's speedometer showing a high speed, indicating a fast journey
A road stretching into the distance with motion blur, suggesting a long drive
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting the act of driving or being driven.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘驾驶或被驱动行为的插图。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 受驱使的，有动力的；v. drive 的过去分词
words.usage: adj. / v. (drive v. (过去式 drove, 过去分词 driven))

examples.en: He is a driven student who always aims for the top.
examples.cn: 他是一个有动力的学生，总是以顶尖为目标。

examples.en: The project was driven by the need for better communication.
examples.cn: 这个项目是由对更好沟通的需求所驱动的。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人非常有上进心，并且努力实现目标，你会怎么形容他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容人有强烈的内在动力，渴望成功。

sentences: The team was ___ to succeed despite facing many challenges.
Her success was ___ by her passion for the subject.

image_prompts: A steering wheel with hands gripping it tightly, road ahead blurred
A car key inserted into the ignition of a vehicle, dashboard visible
words.image_desc_en: Driving a car; car keys in the ignition.
words.image_desc_cn: 驾驶汽车；汽车钥匙在点火器中。
words.usage: v. (过去式 drove, 过去分词 driven) to force someone to act in a particular way
words.collocations: drive sb crazy, drive sb mad, drive sb to do sth
words.preposition_combos: drive sb into (a corner), drive sb out of (business)

examples.en: The strict rules drive students to study harder for exams.
examples.cn: 严格的规定促使学生们更加努力地为考试学习。

examples.en: His constant complaints drive me crazy; I can't stand it.
examples.cn: 他不停的抱怨快把我逼疯了；我受不了了。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人总是让你感到非常生气或沮丧，你会用什么词来形容他的行为？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示某人的行为导致你产生强烈的情绪反应，比如愤怒或烦躁。

sentences: The pressure of the competition ___ her to work even harder.

image_prompts: A graph showing an upward trend, indicating increasing values
A set of weights on a scale, with one side gradually outweighing the other
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing increasing quantity or degree.
words.image_desc_cn: 表示数量或程度增加的插图。
words.usage: 用于表示随着一个数量或程度的增加，另一个数量或程度也随之增加。
words.collocations: the more... the more...

examples.en: The more you practice, the more skilled you will become.
examples.cn: 你练习得越多，你就会变得越熟练。

examples.en: The more books you read, the more knowledge you gain.
examples.cn: 你读的书越多，你获得的知识就越多。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你投入更多的时间学习，你的考试成绩会如何变化？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这里需要一个表示两者都增加的结构。

sentences: ___ you study, ___ you learn; it's a simple rule.
___ you give, ___ you receive; that's the law of nature.

image_prompts: A calendar with several dates crossed out, indicating the passage of time
A growing plant with new leaves, symbolizing recent development
words.image_desc_en: A calendar with crossed-out dates and a plant with new leaves.
words.image_desc_cn: 日历上划掉了许多日期，以及一株长出新叶的植物。
words.collocations: have lately, quite lately

examples.en: I haven't seen him lately; I wonder where he is.
examples.cn: 我最近没见过他；我想知道他在哪里。

examples.en: She has been studying very hard lately for the exam.
examples.cn: 她最近为了考试一直在努力学习。

socratic_questions.question: 如果某件事你过去一段时间没有做，但现在开始做了，可以用哪个词来表示这段“现在开始”的时间？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示一段时间内，通常指最近一段时间。

sentences: Have you been feeling well ___? You seem a bit tired.
I haven't seen her ___ at the library.

image_prompts: Two intertwined friendship bracelets on a wooden table, soft lighting
A jigsaw puzzle with two pieces perfectly fitting together, vibrant colors
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations representing close relationships and compatibility.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表亲密关系和兼容性的插图。
words.collocations: become friends with, stay friends with, remain friends with

examples.en: I hope I can be friends with her in the future.
examples.cn: 我希望将来能和她成为朋友。

examples.en: It's easy to be friends with someone who shares your interests.
examples.cn: 和有共同兴趣的人交朋友很容易。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想和新同学建立良好的关系，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表达你想和对方建立友谊。

sentences: She wants to ___ all her classmates this year.

image_prompts: A handwritten list with one item crossed out with a thick black line
A group of puzzle pieces with one piece missing from the completed puzzle
words.image_desc_en: A list with an item crossed out; a puzzle with a missing piece.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个项目被划掉的清单；一个缺少一块的拼图。
words.usage: v. to not include someone or something
words.collocations: leave out details, leave out names, leave out information

examples.en: Please don't leave out any important details in your report.
examples.cn: 请不要在你的报告中遗漏任何重要的细节。

examples.en: The teacher told him not to leave out any words.
examples.cn: 老师告诉他不要遗漏任何单词。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在写一份清单，但忘记写上一个东西，你会怎么说？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 表达“忘记包含”的意思。

sentences: Make sure you don't ___ any key points in your essay.

image_prompts: Two intertwined oak trees with strong roots, sunlight filtering through leaves
A jigsaw puzzle with many pieces fitting perfectly together, vibrant colors
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of strong bonds and perfect connections.
words.image_desc_cn: 象征牢固关系和完美连接的插图。
words.collocations: build a friendship, true friendship, lasting friendship

examples.en: Our friendship began in middle school, and it's still strong.
examples.cn: 我们的友谊始于初中，而且现在仍然很牢固。

examples.en: Friendship is important for happiness and emotional well-being.
examples.cn: 友谊对幸福和情感健康非常重要。

socratic_questions.question: 当你和某人分享快乐和悲伤，互相支持，这种关系通常被称为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这种关系强调互相的喜爱、信任和尊重。

sentences: The strong ___ between them helped them overcome many difficulties.

image_prompts: A golden crown resting on a red velvet cushion, ornate details
A chess piece shaped like a king, standing tall on a chessboard
words.image_desc_en: Images depicting a king's crown and a chess king piece.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘国王王冠和国际象棋国王棋子的图像。
words.collocations: king of the jungle, king size, king and queen

examples.en: The king ruled the country with wisdom and justice.
examples.cn: 国王以智慧和公正统治着这个国家。

examples.en: He felt like the king of the world after winning the game.
examples.cn: 赢得比赛后，他感觉自己像世界之王。

socratic_questions.question: 谁是统治国家的最高统治者？

sentences: The ___ made a speech to his people on national day.

image_prompts: A perfectly ripe, red tomato on a vine in a sunny garden
A graph showing a bell curve with the peak highlighted in bright color
words.image_desc_en: A ripe tomato and a bell curve highlighting the peak.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个成熟的西红柿和一个突出显示峰值的钟形曲线。
words.meaning_cn: adj. 首要的；最佳的；n. 鼎盛时期
words.collocations: prime example, prime time, in its prime

examples.en: This park is a prime location for summer picnics with friends.
examples.cn: 这个公园是和朋友们夏天野餐的首选地点。

examples.en: She is in her prime now, achieving great success in music.
examples.cn: 她现在正值鼎盛时期，在音乐方面取得了巨大的成功。

socratic_questions.question: 什么时期是植物生长最旺盛、果实最饱满的时候？什么位置是做某事最理想的？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑事物发展最好的阶段，或者最适合做某事的地点。

sentences: This area is a ___ spot for bird watching during migration season.

image_prompts: A gavel resting on a wooden desk in a government building
A podium with a microphone in a large hall, flags in the background
words.image_desc_en: Images representing government and leadership.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表政府和领导力的图片。
words.collocations: prime minister, foreign minister, cabinet minister

examples.en: The Minister of Education announced new policies for schools today.
examples.cn: 教育部长今天宣布了学校的新政策。

examples.en: Our foreign minister will visit several countries to promote cooperation.
examples.cn: 我们的外交部长将访问几个国家以促进合作。

socratic_questions.question: 在政府中，谁负责管理特定的部门，例如教育或外交？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人通常是政府的高级成员，负责制定和执行政策。

sentences: The ___ of Health is responsible for public health policies.

image_prompts: A photograph of a government building with flags waving outside
A formal portrait of a person in a suit standing at a podium
words.image_desc_en: Images representing leadership and government.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表领导力和政府的图像。
words.collocations: meet with the prime minister, former prime minister
words.preposition_combos: of the prime minister, to the prime minister

examples.en: The prime minister announced new economic policies at the conference.
examples.cn: 首相在会议上宣布了新的经济政策。

examples.en: Our prime minister will visit several countries next month for talks.
examples.cn: 我们的首相下个月将访问几个国家进行会谈。

socratic_questions.question: 哪个政府官员通常负责领导一个国家的政府，并且经常在重要决策中发挥关键作用？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是政府的首脑。

sentences: The ___ held a press conference to address the nation.

image_prompts: A large vault door with combination lock, stacks of gold bars inside
A fountain pen resting on a financial document with charts and graphs
words.image_desc_en: A vault with gold bars and a pen on financial documents.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个装满金条的保险库，以及放在金融文件上的钢笔。
words.collocations: investment banker, senior banker, local banker

examples.en: The banker advised her on the best investment opportunities available.
examples.cn: 银行家向她建议了最好的投资机会。

examples.en: My father works as a banker at a large international firm.
examples.cn: 我的父亲在一家大型国际公司担任银行家。

socratic_questions.question: 谁是管理和投资大量金钱的专业人士？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个人通常在银行工作，并且精通金融事务。

sentences: The wealthy businessman consulted with his personal ___ about his finances.

image_prompts: A golden star on a red carpet, spotlights shining brightly
A newspaper headline announcing an award winner, bold font
words.image_desc_en: Images representing recognition and public attention.
words.image_desc_cn: 代表认可和公众关注的图像。
words.collocations: gain fame, achieve fame, worldwide fame

examples.en: She achieved great fame after her role in the popular movie.
examples.cn: 她在热门电影中扮演角色后获得了巨大的名声。

examples.en: He wanted fame, but he also valued his privacy a lot.
examples.cn: 他想要名声，但他也非常重视他的隐私。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人因为他的成就而被很多人知道和尊敬，这是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词描述的是被公众广泛认可的状态。

sentences: The young artist hoped to gain ___ through her unique paintings.

image_prompts: A white rose with very light pink edges, soft lighting
A faded photograph of a landscape, colors washed out and muted
words.image_desc_en: A light color or faded appearance.
words.image_desc_cn: 浅颜色或褪色的外观。
words.collocations: pale face, pale light, pale skin

examples.en: She looked pale after the long exam, needing some rest.
examples.cn: 考完漫长的考试后，她看起来很苍白，需要休息一下。

examples.en: The pale moonlight shone through the window, lighting the room.
examples.cn: 苍白的月光透过窗户照进来，照亮了房间。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人脸色不好，看起来没有血色，我们通常会用什么词来形容他/她的脸色？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词形容缺乏颜色，像白色一样。

sentences: After staying indoors for weeks, his skin looked quite ___.

image_prompts: A chess piece depicting a queen on a checkered board, strategic lighting
An ornate crown with jewels displayed on a velvet cushion, royal setting
words.image_desc_en: A chess queen and a jeweled crown.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个国际象棋的后和一个镶满珠宝的皇冠。
words.collocations: queen bee, beauty queen
words.preposition_combos: of a queen, for the queen

examples.en: The queen visited our school and gave a speech today.
examples.cn: 今天女王访问了我们学校并发表了演讲。

examples.en: She wants to be the queen of the school dance this year.
examples.cn: 她想成为今年学校舞会的皇后。

socratic_questions.question: 在童话故事中，谁通常住在城堡里，拥有最高的权力？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个角色通常是女性，并且统治着一个国家。

sentences: The ___ ruled the country with wisdom and kindness for many years.

image_prompts: A telephone receiver with a hand dialing a number, emergency lights flashing in background
A doctor's office waiting room, empty chairs, a sign indicating 'Please sign in'
words.image_desc_en: Calling someone for help or reporting something.
words.image_desc_cn: 打电话寻求帮助或报告某事。
words.collocations: call in sick, call in a favor, call in the experts

examples.en: She had to call in sick because of a bad cold.
examples.cn: 她因为重感冒不得不打电话请病假。

examples.en: We may need to call in a plumber to fix the leak.
examples.cn: 我们可能需要打电话找个水管工来修理漏水。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你生病了不能去上学，你会做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 你需要通知学校你不能去，通常通过电话。

sentences: He had to ___ ___ to work because he was feeling unwell.

image_prompts: A magnifying glass over a detailed map, focusing on a specific location
A doctor's stethoscope placed on a medical chart, close-up view
words.image_desc_en: Magnifying glass over a map; stethoscope on a medical chart.
words.image_desc_cn: 放大镜在地图上；听诊器在病历上。
words.collocations: examine carefully, examine closely, examine evidence

examples.en: The teacher will examine our test papers after school today.
examples.cn: 今天放学后老师会检查我们的试卷。

examples.en: We should examine all the facts before making a decision.
examples.cn: 在做决定之前，我们应该审查所有的事实。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你需要找出某件事的真相或问题所在，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 需要仔细观察和分析，寻找证据。

sentences: The police will ___ the crime scene for any clues carefully.

image_prompts: A road sign showing two diverging paths, neither of which is marked with a destination
A closed door with two knockers, neither of which produces a sound when used
words.image_desc_en: Two scenarios where neither option is viable or available.
words.image_desc_cn: 两种情况下，两个选项都不可行或不可用。
words.collocations: neither...nor...

examples.en: He doesn't like apples, nor does he like pears.
examples.cn: 他不喜欢苹果，也不喜欢梨。

examples.en: She can't sing, nor can she play any musical instrument.
examples.cn: 她不会唱歌，也不会演奏任何乐器。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人不喜欢A，并且同样不喜欢B，你会用哪个词来连接这两个否定?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“也不”，用于连接两个否定的陈述。

sentences: I haven't finished my homework, ___ have my classmates.

image_prompts: Two identical closed boxes side by side, both unopened, representing a lack of choice
A fork in a road with signs pointing to two different destinations, both crossed out
words.image_desc_en: Two options are unavailable or not chosen.
words.image_desc_cn: 两个选项都不可用或未被选择。
words.collocations: neither...nor...

examples.en: Neither my brother nor I like playing computer games at all.
examples.cn: 我和我的弟弟都不喜欢玩电脑游戏。

examples.en: She speaks neither English nor French fluently, which is a pity.
examples.cn: 她英语和法语都不流利，这很可惜。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的朋友既不喜欢足球，也不喜欢篮球，你会用哪个词来描述这种情况？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示两个选项都不成立。

sentences: ___ of my parents is able to attend my school's open day.

image_prompts: A grand palace with golden domes and intricate carvings, viewed from a distance
The throne room inside a palace, featuring a large throne and royal banners
words.image_desc_en: A grand and luxurious royal residence.
words.image_desc_cn: 宏伟豪华的皇家住所。
words.collocations: royal palace, ancient palace, visit a palace
words.preposition_combos: in a palace, near the palace, of the palace

examples.en: The royal family lives in a beautiful palace near the capital.
examples.cn: 皇室家族住在首都附近一座美丽的宫殿里。

examples.en: We visited an ancient palace that was once home to emperors.
examples.cn: 我们参观了一座古老的宫殿，那里曾经是皇帝的住所。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你想参观国王或女王居住的地方，那会是什么样的建筑？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 通常是很大很豪华的建筑，是皇室的住所。

sentences: The Queen lives in a large ___ with many rooms and gardens.

image_prompts: A large pile of gold coins and precious jewels overflowing from a treasure chest
A sprawling mansion with a long driveway and perfectly manicured gardens, under a sunny sky
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations depicting abundance and luxury.
words.image_desc_cn: 描绘富裕和奢华的插图。
words.collocations: great wealth, personal wealth, create wealth, share wealth

examples.en: His family's wealth allowed him to travel around the world.
examples.cn: 他家的财富使他能够环游世界。

examples.en: Education is a kind of wealth that no one can take away.
examples.cn: 教育是一种无人能夺走的财富。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有很多钱，可以用来做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指的是拥有的很多金钱或有价值的东西。

sentences: The country's natural resources contribute to its overall ___.

image_prompts: A blank notebook with a pen resting on the first page, ready to be filled with writing
A race track with cars lined up at the starting line, engines revving
words.image_desc_en: A notebook ready for writing and cars at a starting line.
words.image_desc_cn: 准备好书写的笔记本和起跑线上的赛车。
words.usage: 短语，表示开始或列举的第一点
words.collocations: to begin with, firstly, initially
words.preposition_combos: start with something, start with doing something

examples.en: To start with, let's review the main points of the lesson.
examples.cn: 首先，让我们回顾一下这节课的要点。

examples.en: To start with, I'd like to thank everyone for coming today.
examples.cn: 首先，我想感谢大家今天的光临。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要列举几个原因，你会用什么短语来引出第一个原因？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示“在开始的时候”或“作为第一点”。

sentences: ___, I want to thank you for your help with the project.

image_prompts: A cloudy sky with dark grey clouds covering the sun
A collection of smooth grey stones on a beach, wet from the tide
words.image_desc_en: Illustrations of grey cloudy sky and grey stones.
words.image_desc_cn: 灰色多云的天空和灰色石头插图。
words.usage: adj. (比较级 greyer, 最高级 greyest)
words.collocations: grey hair, grey area, grey sky

examples.en: The sky was grey and cloudy before the heavy rain started.
examples.cn: 在下大雨之前，天空是灰色的，多云。

examples.en: My grandma has some grey hair, but she is still very active.

examples.cn: 我无法挑剔她那份优秀的家庭作业。

words.collocations: disappoint someone; disappoint expectations; great disappointment
